verdicts.reason: A shrinks the crowd illustration into a small strip in the top-left, leaving dead white space beside it and losing the key image. Its quote breaks badly, with an orphaned 'OF THOUGHTFUL' line and a ragged 'THE WORLD; INDEED,', and the attribution needlessly wraps onto two lines. B keeps the crowd large and full-width across the top, so it stays faithful to the original. It shares the same awkward forced breaks ('OF THOUGHTFUL' orphan), and its text block and one-line attribution sit cramped against the left, right and bottom edges with almost no margin.
